fact: Mobile operators in Senegal must identify SIM buyers under Decree 2007-937, and on ARTP's orders the biometric ID database is made available to the operators to verify individuals' identities, through one-way interoperability channels between the DAF's files and those of telecoms operators and banks, as reported in 2025.
title: Biometric Digital-ID in Africa: Progress and Challenges to Date – Ten Country Case Studies (Senegal Country Report)
